svg.title: Goose runtime by backend and Wasm engine

cc:Work.dc:title: Goose runtime by backend and Wasm engine
cc:Work.dc:description: Seven adapted LangArena workloads. Medians of 5 samples; whiskers show median absolute deviation. Lower is better. One fresh same-host cohort measures all three backends with the same current compiler and adapted sources. Backends are not interleaved pairs. Direct Wasm is memory32; C-to-Wasm is memory64. Native reference is repeated in both engine panels.
